rationale: RANK is a monotone transform of the already-archived "Near Term Funding Gap," so the decile sort and every portfolio statistic are mechanically unchanged and only the Fama-MacBeth number moves — this is a cosmetic re-specification of an evaluated signal rather than a new construct, and the winsorized ratio's tail contamination could equally be diagnosed without consuming a proposal slot.

target_name: Funding Gap Net Of Internal Cash Generation
rationale: Adding operating cash flow to the sources term is a genuine economic change that converts a balance-sheet snapshot into an external-financing need, but the proposal understates that oancf already embeds the working-capital change appearing in the numerator's accrual term, so part of the "improvement" is a partial cancellation of the soft-asset leg rather than a clean addition.

The level-versus-change question is well motivated by the archive's rising-leverage result and does purge persistent capital-intensity effects, but because the level already contains DELTA(act−che), this is effectively a second difference of working capital deflated by a moving sales base, which is likely to be dominated by measurement noise.

target_name: Unbacked Earnings Meeting A Funding Gap
rationale: The MIN conjunction is correctly signed (high only when both legs are high) and the interaction with a funding-gap state is not a plain accruals rediscovery, but the claim of "no mechanical overlap" is simply wrong — ib−oancf is the standard cash-flow accrual measure and shares its working-capital component with the gap leg — so any incremental power over the gap alone will be hard to attribute.

target_name: Accruals Against Maturity And Coverage Pressure
rationale: This is the third variant of the same accrual-leg-times-dlc/lt conditioner, differing from the archived "Accruals Against Cash Adjusted Rollover Pressure" only by swapping the cash-stock buffer (che/lct) for a flow coverage term (oancf/lt) inside the same SUMRANK, which is the kind of one-input cosmetic tweak the objective explicitly discourages.

The U-shape hypothesis is a genuinely different structural claim and worth one clean test against the archive's best conditioner, but the prior is unfavorable — the archived ABS-based opacity signal under fragility produced a significantly *wrong*-signed alpha (+3.5%, t=2.64), and discarding sign throws away the information driving the −3.7 t-stat on the signed version.
